description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the raw-command-line cluster of ConsoleArgumentsTests with a safe Windows-compatible tokenizer feeding the existing Rust conhost argument state machine.

entries.notes: Safe Rust now owns the raw command-line boundary: Windows quote/backslash tokenization feeds the existing conhost parser and reproduces Microsoft's headless, quoted client, server-handle, whitespace, backslash-space/tab and implicit-client vectors.
The direct witness covers explicit -- separation, implicit client takeover, embedded host-looking arguments after client takeover, empty explicit client and empty command line.
The raw owner preserves the legacy bare 0x server-handle launch and historical \??\ executable-path leader behavior before deterministic host switches are parsed.
